title: A new case
instructions: Read what happened, then choose the best answer.

parts.prompt: Mira got a cloze gap wrong. She knew “although” and “because”, but she read only the words next to the gap and missed the surprise in the next sentence. Which reason and next step fit best?

options.text: Reasoning: read the next sentence first
Knowledge: learn a new list of words
Time: answer all the questions faster
Attention: read the title once more

choice_rationales.A: She knew the words but did not use the later clue.
choice_rationales.D: The title is not the problem.

parts.correct_explanation: She knew the words but missed later evidence, so she should read further before choosing.
